page.layout: One printed page. Running head at the top. Below it, a title block in roman type, then italic Latin verse. A second title block follows, then a second verse passage. The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of many lines.

main_text.l: ante vltimam operi tanto manum im-

l.i: Perplexa euoluens, & clara in luce reponens
Sicne opere in medio, nos, Bucolzere, relictos
At te parte operis liceat plus dicere laudis
Quam nimium multos, operis quae falsa peraeti
Hebdomas una, Deo verbum genitale loquute,
Sic repetens certo septena volumina gyro,
Æuum impertitur mundo, sese haec fatenti

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of most lines, so the endings of the title and verse lines are missing. Several words in the first title block are cut mid-word at the edge.
